title: Shared Riddle · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Shared Riddle · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a familiar object. The pair takes turns giving one truthful clue each without naming the object. The group identifies the intended object from the two clues. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Shared Riddle, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group identifies the intended object from the two clues.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group identifies the intended object from the two clues.
